title: Berberine administrated with different routes attenuates inhaled LPS-induced acute respiratory distress syndrome through TLR4/NF-kappaB and JAK2/STAT3 inhibition.
authors: Xu, Guanghui; Wan, Huiqi; Yi, Litao; Chen, Wei; Luo, Youhua; Huang, Yiqi; Liu, Xiaojuan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究小檗碱经不同给药途径对LPS诱导ARDS的肺保护作用，聚焦TLR4/NF-kB和JAK2/STAT3炎症信号通路，仅涉及小分子-蛋白对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，与本课题无关。
abstract: Accumulating evidence showed that berberine possessed the anti-inflammatory action in various diseases caused by inflammation. However, it was still unclear whether both inhalation and injection with berberine produced pulmonary protective role in acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS). This study was aimed to evaluate the effects of both administration routes including inhalation and injection with berberine in ARDS induced by lipopolysaccharide (LPS) inhalation. Histopathological examination and weight of lung were evaluated. Phosphorylation of NF-kappaB, JAK2 and STAT3 were measured to assess the activity of inflammation related signaling pathways. Proinflammatory cytokines including interleukin (IL)-1beta and tumor necrosis factor (TNF)-alpha in the bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) and serum were also detected. The results showed that LPS caused the lung injury, while both administration routes with berberine attenuated the injury and improved the pulmonary morphology. In addition, the primary TLR4/NF-kappaB and secondary JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathways which were activated by LPS in lung were totally inhibited by berberine administration. Moreover, proinflammatory cytokines in both BALF and serum were decreased by berberine. Considering that molecular docking simulation indicated that berberine could bind with TLR4, the present suggested that the inhibition of the inflammation related TLR4/NF-kappaB and JAK2/STAT3 signaling pathways might be involved in the pulmonary protective effect of berberine in LPS-induced ARDS.
abstract_zh: 越来越多的证据表明，小檗碱在多种由炎症引起的疾病中具有抗炎作用。然而，小檗碱通过吸入和注射两种给药方式在急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）中是否均能发挥肺部保护作用尚不清楚。本研究旨在评估小檗碱经吸入和注射两种给药途径对脂多糖（LPS）吸入诱导的ARDS的影响。通过组织病理学检查和肺重评估肺部状况。检测NF-kappaB、JAK2和STAT3的磷酸化水平以评估炎症相关信号通路的活性。同时检测支气管肺泡灌洗液（BALF）和血清中的促炎细胞因子，包括白细胞介素（IL）-1β和肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）-α。结果显示，LPS导致肺损伤，而小檗碱的两种给药途径均能减轻损伤并改善肺部形态。此外，LPS在肺中激活的初级TLR4/NF-kappaB和次级JAK2/STAT3信号通路均被小檗碱给药完全抑制。而且，小檗碱降低了BALF和血清中的促炎细胞因子水平。鉴于分子对接模拟表明小檗碱能与TLR4结合，本研究提示，抑制炎症相关的TLR4/NF-kappaB和JAK2/STAT3信号通路可能参与小檗碱在LPS诱导的ARDS中的肺部保护作用。
